# Step 1: Determine which parents already have Venmo accounts by searching users by email (with pagination)

# Ensure tokens exist
if 'phone_token' not in globals() or not phone_token:
    phone_pw=[x['password'] for x in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords() if x['account_name']=='phone'][0]
    phone_login=apis.phone.login(username='7763361246', password=phone_pw)
    phone_token=phone_login.get('access_token')

if 'venmo_token' not in globals() or not venmo_token:
    venmo_pw=[x['password'] for x in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords() if x['account_name']=='venmo'][0]
    venmo_login=apis.venmo.login(username='chelsea-burch@gmail.com', password=venmo_pw)
    venmo_token=venmo_login.get('access_token')

# Ensure parents list exists
if 'parents' not in globals():
    # fetch parents
    parents=[]
    page_index=0
    page_limit=20
    while True:
        page=apis.phone.search_contacts(access_token=phone_token, relationship='parent', page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
        if not page:
            break
        parents.extend(page)
        page_index+=1

emails=[p.get('email') for p in parents]
print('parent_emails', emails)

venmo_found_by_email={}
venmo_users_by_email={}

for email in emails:
    all_matches=[]
    page_index=0
    page_limit=20
    while True:
        res=apis.venmo.search_users(access_token=venmo_token, query=email, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
        # API returns list
        if not res:
            break
        all_matches.extend(res)
        # defensive: if fewer than page_limit, likely last page but still rely on empty-next via loop
        page_index+=1
    venmo_users_by_email[email]=all_matches
    venmo_found_by_email[email]=len(all_matches)>0
    print('email', email, 'found', len(all_matches))
    if len(all_matches)>0:
        print('  matches', all_matches)

print('venmo_found_by_email', venmo_found_by_email)
# Create list of parents needing accounts
need_accounts=[p for p in parents if not venmo_found_by_email.get(p.get('email'))]
print('need_accounts_count', len(need_accounts))
print('need_accounts', [(p.get('first_name'), p.get('last_name'), p.get('email')) for p in need_accounts])

if 'venmo_token' not in globals() or not globals().get('venmo_token'):
    venmo_pw=[x['password'] for x in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords() if x['account_name']=='venmo'][0]
    venmo_login=apis.venmo.login(username='chelsea-burch@gmail.com', password=venmo_pw)
    venmo_token=venmo_login.get('access_token')

# Fetch parents again (paginated)
parents=[]
page_index=0
page_limit=20
while True:
    page=apis.phone.search_contacts(access_token=phone_token, relationship='parent', page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    if not page:
        break
    parents.extend(page)
    page_index += 1

parent_emails=[p.get('email') for p in parents]
print('parent_emails', parent_emails)

exact_matches_by_email={}
for email in parent_emails:
    all_matches=[]
    page_index=0
    page_limit=20
    while True:
        res=apis.venmo.search_users(access_token=venmo_token, query=email, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
        if not res:
            break
        all_matches.extend(res)
        page_index += 1
    exact=[u for u in all_matches if u.get('email')==email]
    exact_matches_by_email[email]=exact
    print('email', email, 'total_matches', len(all_matches), 'exact_matches', len(exact))
    if exact:
        # show first 3 exact matches
        for i,u in enumerate(exact[:3]):
            print('  exact', i, u)

need_accounts=[email for email in parent_emails if len(exact_matches_by_email.get(email,[]))==0]
